plugins.name: spindoctor-qwerty
plugins.description: SpinDoctor 3.1.2 quantum-circuit SIMULATOR for Factory Droid: q.* scripts (1-298 logical qubits), the 241 presets, q.folder, theory testing from files or the chat, TXT/PDF/JSON/CSV reports, via a bundled standard-library-only Python MCP server. Classical FP64 simulation, not a quantum computer.
